title: Metal 2 on A11 - Raster Order Groups
description: Raster order groups allow Metal 2 apps to precisely control the order of parallel fragment shader threads accessing the same pixel coordinates. Learn how A11 extends raster order groups with support for multiple groups and adds new capabilities for accessing threadgroup memory. See how you can improve the performance of single pass deferred shading and order independent transparency.

resources.title: Tailor Your Apps for Apple GPUs and Tile-Based Deferred Rendering
resources.description: Learn about characteristic Apple GPU features, including imageblocks, tile shaders, and raster order groups.

resources.title: Rendering a scene with deferred lighting in Objective-C
resources.description: Avoid expensive lighting calculations by implementing a deferred lighting renderer optimized for immediate mode and tile-based deferred renderer GPUs.

resources.title: Order Independent Transparency with Imageblocks
resources.description: This sample demonstrates and implementation of multi layered alpha blending, an algorithm to achieve order independent transparency.
